_help: Act 4, day 1: Charlie Whitfield at the American camp. Standing with him is the stat [whitfield, trust]. A hint about one of the sites his expedition claimed sets hint_<site> only (no clue).

first.speaker: whitfield
first.line: Well, look who made it! Charlie Whitfield, and that's my outfit you're admiring. Biggest camp on the site, and the best coffee this side of the Nile.

wager_on.speaker: whitfield
wager_on.line: And don't think I've forgotten our little bet. Five thousand dollars says my boys find the real prize before yours do.

wager_off.speaker: whitfield
wager_off.line: Shame you wouldn't take my bet. Five thousand dollars would have made this a whole lot more fun.

again.speaker: whitfield
again.line: Back again? Careful, folks will say you're working for me.

menu.speaker: whitfield
menu.line: So, what can I do for you?

choices.label: Congratulate him
choices.line: That was some arrival, Whitfield. If anyone finds a king's ransom out here, it'll be you.

choices.label: Needle him
choices.line: Whatever's down there belongs in a museum, not in your parlour back in New York.

choices.label: Ask about his men
choices.line: You've brought a lot of rifles for a dig.

pleased.speaker: whitfield
pleased.line: Now that's the spirit! Tell you what, since you're a sport...

hint_anubis.speaker: whitfield
hint_anubis.line: My boys were poking round that jackal statue. Something under its feet rings hollow when you knock on it. Don't tell anyone I said so.

hint_scarabs.speaker: whitfield
hint_scarabs.line: That wall of green beetles? Maggie swears one of them is the wrong way round. Two hundred scarabs and she counts them. That's what I pay her for.

hint_storeroom.speaker: whitfield
hint_storeroom.line: We cracked the seal on that storeroom. Whoever closed it up did it from the inside. Gave Red the creeps, and nothing gives Red the creeps.

hint_none.speaker: whitfield
hint_none.line: Ah, but I'd better keep my cards close until we've turned something up. Ask me again tomorrow.

stung.speaker: whitfield
stung.line: A museum? Pal, I paid for every camel and every shovel in this camp. What I dig up, I keep. You'd do the same if you had the money.

men.speaker: whitfield
men.line: Red Callahan runs my security. Desert's full of bandits, and I'm not about to lose my investment to some fellow on a camel.

bye.speaker: whitfield
bye.line: See you at the finish line!
